clips.title: The story
paras: Warsong Oil is a crucial industrial lubricant intended for the machinery at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale. A vital supply shipment was intercepted en route by local satyrs, who took the oil to their corrupted woodland sanctuaries for foul rituals.

The Warsong Clan's logging efforts in Ashenvale rely heavily on heavy machinery, goblin-engineered shredders, and massive sawmills. Keeping this industrial equipment running requires a steady supply of specialized oil. Without it, the clan's timber harvest risks grinding to an abrupt halt, stalling the flow of lumber desperately needed to build Orgrimmar and fortify Horde settlements across Durotar and the Barrens.

Rather than reaching Splintertree Post and the logging camps, a recent shipment of Warsong Oil was ambushed by the satyrs infesting the forest. Instead of discarding the refined fluid, the demonic servants carried the containers into their corrupted enclaves—including Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian—to use the flammable lubricant in their dark, detestable rituals.
